overview.title: What is Frontier Tower?
overview.text:
Frontier Tower is a 16-story vertical village at 995 Market Street in San Francisco for 700+ founders and builders in AI, biotech, crypto, and deep tech.

The 90,500 sq ft building in San Francisco's Mid-Market neighborhood organizes each floor around a specific technology vertical - AI, biotech, longevity, crypto, robotics, neurotech, arts, and human flourishing. The community hosts more than 100 events monthly, from pitch nights and hackathons to workshops and founder dinners.

overview.title: Who joins Frontier Tower?
overview.text:
Frontier Tower draws startup founders, researchers, engineers, and investors working on problems in AI, biotech, longevity, cryptocurrency, robotics, neurotech, and consciousness research. Members range from pre-seed founders to VCs and scientists who want a community-governed workspace in San Francisco.

Startups based at Frontier Tower include Onairos (personal data management) and Muse Bio (stem cell research). The 700+ member community has collectively raised more than $150 million.

history.text:
Frontier Tower was founded by Jakob Drzazga, Christian Nagel, and Christian Peters, three German entrepreneurs with backgrounds in venture capital, fintech, and real estate development. Their company, BerlinHouse, purchased the 16-story building at 995 Market Street in January 2025 for $11 million through its acquisition vehicle, Deep Ink Ventures.

The BerlinHouse concept draws from post-Berlin Wall history, when vacant buildings in East Berlin became vibrant clubs, art spaces, and hacker houses. The founders saw a parallel in San Francisco's Mid-Market district, where commercial real estate had collapsed - the 995 Market building was assessed at $62 million in 2016 before selling for $11 million. The building previously served as a WeWork facility and as the headquarters of the Burning Man Project.

Frontier Tower opened to members in 2025 and has since grown to 700+ members across 16 themed floors. Co-living for residents is provided through a partner property, [Superhero Hotel](https://www.superherohotel.com/), a separate historic 1920 building at 825 Sutter Street in Nob Hill acquired by the same team.

location:
Frontier Tower sits at 995 Market Street (corner of 6th and Market) in San Francisco's Mid-Market neighborhood, CA 94103. The building is 16 stories tall and approximately 90,500 sq ft, with each floor covering roughly 4,250 sq ft.

Floors are organized around distinct technology verticals: AI, cryptocurrency (home to an Ethereum House lounge), neurotech, longevity and biotech, robotics, arts and music, consciousness research, and human flourishing. Named event spaces include the Spaceship on the 2nd floor (capacity 200 standing or 120 seated, used for talks, panels, and product launches) and the Lounge on the 16th floor with panoramic skyline views. The building also has a rooftop deck, gym, kitchen, focus zones, and a robotics lab with access to advanced equipment.

The co-living partner, [Superhero Hotel](https://www.superherohotel.com/), is a separate historic building at 825 Sutter Street in Nob Hill - a 10-minute walk from the Tower.
duration:
Frontier Tower membership is flexible. A private day office is available for short visits. Monthly memberships run month-to-month with no minimum commitment; annual memberships lock in a lower rate.

For a full live-in experience, the partner [Superhero Hotel](https://www.superherohotel.com/) at 825 Sutter Street (Nob Hill) offers a Day-by-Day track with a 3-night minimum, or a 4-week residency program - both include full Frontier Tower access and 50+ monthly events.

The [Viva Frontier Tower](https://viva.city/frontier-tower) program is a structured 6-week cohort running June 20 through August 4, 2026, with tracks in longevity, AI, crypto, neurotech, robotics, and arts. The Frontier Residency is a multi-month intensive for 10 selected founding teams, including weekly feedback sessions, a 4-day offsite retreat, and a Demo Day pitch to investors.
pricing:
Founding Citizenship (24/7 building access, events, governance): $190/month or $1,800/year.

Coworking Membership (hot desk + citizenship): from $219/month.

Private Office (office rent, requires active Founding Citizenship): from $1,100/month for a 2-person office; larger offices up to $4,000/month.

Private Day Office: from $300/day.

[Superhero Hotel](https://www.superherohotel.com/) co-living at 825 Sutter St, Nob Hill (10-min walk): Day-by-Day from $200/night with a 3-night minimum; 4-week residency programs from $1,980 - both include full Frontier Tower access and 50+ monthly events.

[Viva Frontier Tower](https://viva.city/frontier-tower) 6-week program (June 20 - August 4, 2026): $950 full access; discounts available for active Frontier Tower members; scholarships available for students, researchers, open-source contributors, and volunteers.
amenities: The Spaceship event venue (2nd floor, 200 standing / 120 seated)
The Lounge (16th floor, skyline views, for dinners and networking)
Robotics lab with access to advanced equipment
Kitchen with complimentary coffee, tea, and healthy snacks
100+ community events monthly (pitch nights, hackathons, workshops, founder dinners)
longtermer:
For extended stays, [Superhero Hotel](https://www.superherohotel.com/) at 825 Sutter Street in Nob Hill (10-minute walk from the Tower) offers 4-week residency programs starting from $1,980. All stays include full access to Frontier Tower, free entry to 50+ monthly events, and access to the community chat.

The Frontier Residency is a more intensive multi-month program for 10 selected founding teams. It includes weekly feedback sessions, a 4-day offsite retreat, curated investor introductions, and a Demo Day. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; the current cohort is closed - check [frontiertower.io](https://frontiertower.io/) for the next opening.

howToEnter.text:
Apply for Founding Citizenship at [frontiertower.io/apply](https://frontiertower.io/apply). The application is open to anyone working in frontier technology; select the floor community you'd like to join (AI, biotech, crypto, robotics, etc.) and your preferred membership tier. Members receive 24/7 building access and free use of event spaces.

For co-living, book directly at [superherohotel.com](https://www.superherohotel.com/). For the 6-week [Viva Frontier Tower](https://viva.city/frontier-tower) program (June 20 - August 4, 2026), register at viva.city with scholarships available for students and researchers.

faqs.question: What is Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Frontier Tower is a 16-story vertical village at 995 Market Street in San Francisco's Mid-Market district. It's a co-working and events hub with themed floors for AI, biotech, crypto, robotics, longevity, neurotech, arts, and human flourishing. The 700+ member community runs more than 100 events monthly.

faqs.question: Where is Frontier Tower located?
faqs.answer: Frontier Tower is at 995 Market Street, San Francisco, CA 94103 - at the corner of 6th and Market in the Mid-Market neighborhood. The address scores 100/100 for walkability and 100/100 for public transit access.

faqs.question: Who founded Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Frontier Tower was founded by Jakob Drzazga (CEO), Christian Nagel, and Christian Peters - three German entrepreneurs with backgrounds in venture capital, fintech, and real estate. Their company, BerlinHouse, acquired the building in January 2025 through its investment arm Deep Ink Ventures for $11 million.

faqs.question: How much does Frontier Tower membership cost?
faqs.answer: Founding Citizenship starts at $190/month or $1,800/year and includes 24/7 access, governance rights, and free use of event spaces. Coworking memberships (hot desk + citizenship) start from $219/month. Private offices range from $1,100 to $4,000/month and require an active Founding Citizen membership. Day access via a private day office starts at $300.

faqs.question: What floor themes does Frontier Tower have?
faqs.answer: Each floor focuses on a specific vertical: AI, cryptocurrency (with an Ethereum House lounge), neurotech, longevity and biotech, robotics, arts and music, consciousness research, and human flourishing. Main event spaces include the Spaceship on the 2nd floor (up to 200 guests) and the Lounge on the 16th floor with skyline views.

faqs.question: What events happen at Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Frontier Tower hosts more than 100 events monthly - pitch nights, hackathons, founder dinners, investor panels, AI paper reading clubs, whitepaper reading groups, and wellness workshops. Some events are members-only; many are open to the public. See the full calendar at [luma.com/frontiertower](https://luma.com/frontiertower).

faqs.question: What is Superhero Hotel and how does it connect to Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Superhero Hotel (825 Sutter St, Nob Hill) is the co-living partner for Frontier Tower - a separate historic 1920 building operated by the same team, a 10-minute walk from the Tower. It offers 110 rooms with a Day-by-Day track (from $200/night, 3-night minimum) and 4-week residency programs (from $1,980). All stays include full Frontier Tower access and 50+ monthly events. Book at [superherohotel.com](https://www.superherohotel.com/).

faqs.question: What is the Frontier Residency?
faqs.answer: The Frontier Residency is an intensive multi-month program for 10 selected founding teams, based at Frontier Tower and Superhero Hotel. It includes weekly feedback sessions, a 4-day offsite retreat, curated investor introductions, and a Demo Day pitch to investors. The current cohort is closed; check [frontiertower.io](https://frontiertower.io/) for the next opening.

faqs.question: What is Viva Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Viva Frontier Tower is a 6-week pop-up community running June 20 through August 4, 2026 at 995 Market Street. It's a structured cohort with tracks in longevity, AI, crypto, neurotech, robotics, and arts, including daily programming, weekly summits, and a Demo Day on August 1. Full access is $950; discounts apply for existing Tower members and scholarships are available for students, researchers, and contributors. Register at [viva.city/frontier-tower](https://viva.city/frontier-tower).

faqs.question: How do I apply to Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Apply for Founding Citizenship at [frontiertower.io/apply](https://frontiertower.io/apply). The application is open to anyone working in frontier technology. For co-living at Superhero Hotel, book at [superherohotel.com](https://www.superherohotel.com/). For the 6-week Viva program, register at [viva.city/frontier-tower](https://viva.city/frontier-tower).

faqs.question: Is Frontier Tower affiliated with BerlinHouse?
faqs.answer: Yes. BerlinHouse is the parent company behind Frontier Tower, inspired by the post-Berlin Wall story of vacant East Berlin buildings becoming vibrant arts and hacker spaces. The company acquired 995 Market Street through its acquisition vehicle Deep Ink Ventures. BerlinHouse's website now redirects to frontiertower.io.

faqs.question: Does Frontier Tower have locations outside San Francisco?
faqs.answer: Frontier Tower has announced a London location at london.frontiertower.io, though details on the London space are limited as of this writing. The San Francisco tower at 995 Market Street is the flagship location.
